name: qlrisk_price_commodity_swap
title: Price a CommoditySwap
description:
Price one Commodity Swap (qlrisk CommoditySwap).
Inputs (* required, name=default): maturity*, notional=1000000, commodity=WTI, convenience_yield_pct=0, quantity, currency=USD. In `advanced` also: effective_date, spot, position.
Example: {"maturity": "5Y", "notional": 1000000} gives NPV -0.00 USD (sample market valued 2026-10-09).
